name: B10-0033/2024 (Renew) – Continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on European Union countries to keep giving Ukraine money and weapons, and to give more and faster. It wants countries to lift limits on how Ukraine can use donated weapons. It asks for long-term funding for Ukraine's recovery, and for Russia's frozen state assets to pay for Ukraine's defence and repairs. It also asks for stronger sanctions on Russia, Iran, North Korea and China, and for Hungary's block on aid to be overcome.

- The Parliament asks for more aid; no law changes yet. It affects Ukraine, European Union countries and Hungary.
- It asks countries to lift weapon-use limits and to send arms faster. Ukraine's army is affected.
- It asks for stronger sanctions and use of frozen Russian assets. Governments decide next.
